description: This file defines the SqsClient class used for interacting with Amazon SQS service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for queue URL to ARN conversion, message attribute MD5 calculation, and request validation logic.

classes.name: SqsClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon SQS, extending AwsClient, with methods for queue ARN conversion and MD5 validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SqsClient, sets up signing with MD5 validation.

methods.name: getQueueArn
methods.description: Converts a queue URL into an AWS ARN format, handling FIFO queue suffixes.

methods.name: calculateMessageAttributesMd5
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 hash of message attributes for validation, following AWS SQS encoding rules.

methods.name: calculateBodyMd5
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 hash of a message body.

methods.name: getEncodedStringPiece
methods.description: Encodes a string as a length-prefixed UTF-8 string.

methods.name: getEncodedBinaryPiece
methods.description: Encodes binary data with a length prefix.

methods.name: getFourBytePieceLength
methods.description: Returns a 4-byte representation of the length of the given binary piece.

methods.name: validateMd5
methods.description: Returns a callable that validates MD5 checksums for 'ReceiveMessage' requests.

calls: Callable functions for MD5 validation on received messages
